🎯 1. ANIQ SAVDO SIGNALI:
─────────────────────────────
● **Instrument:** Gold (XAU/USD) (XAUUSD) • 1m/5m Scalp
● **Buyruq:** 🟢 BUY (LIMIT — Discount zonaga qaytishni kutamiz)
● **⚡ Kirish Vaqti:** Limit Buyurtma: **4594.00** (Narx hozir 4603.90 da — SMC kirish nuqtasidan $11+ uzoqlashgan, KECH QUVMAYMIZ! OTE 0.705 + FVG 50% CE retestida snayper kirish)
● **Kirish (Entry):** 4594.00
● **Stop Loss (SL):** 4583.80 (−$10.20 / ~102 pip — OB Demand pastki chegarasi 4590.53 va SSL 4591.56 supurilishi orqasida, ATR xavfsiz masofa $10.13 dan yuqori)
● **TP1:** 4609.30 (+$15.30 / 1.5R — Sniper Scalp nishoni 4611.50 oldida)
● **TP2:** 4621.50 (+$27.50 / 2.7R — Supply zona 4622.32 boshlanishi oldida)
● **TP3:** 4635.00 (+$41.00 / 4.0R — Supply cho'qqisi 4636.13 va Bearish Breaker 4626.92 ortidagi BSL likvidligi)
● **Confluence (Ishonchlilik):** 91% (MTF 94% Bullish + SMT Bullish + SMC Sweep + OTE/FVG mos tushdi)
● **Risk-Reward (R:R):** 1:2.7 (TP2 asosida), 1:4.0 (TP3 asosida)
● **Boshqaruv Vaqti:** 5 — 15 daqiqa (Limit faollashgach)

🔍 2. ELITA STRATEGIYALAR BO'YICHA JONLI GRAFIK TAHLILI:
─────────────────────────────
• **🏛️ Smart Money & Timing:** SMC allaqachon 4592.24 da likvidlik supurilishi va Rejection bilan BUY berdi — narx 4603.90 gacha ko'tarildi. Bu bizning **Zero-Lag qoidamiz** bo'yicha bozorga hozir kirish = kech kirish demakdir. Institutsional yondashuv: narxning Discount zonaga (4594 atrofi) qaytishini Limit bilan kutish. Xotira sabog'i: oldingi XAUUSD BUY @ 4597 aynan shu retest modelida TP olgan edi ✅

• **⚡ Sniper Scalp & M1/M5 Impuls:** 1m/5m Bullish mikro-impuls faol, tezkor nishon 4611.50. Micro-FVG lar yuqoriga ochilgan — lekin impulsning 50% qaytishida (4594-4595) kirish snayperlik hisoblanadi, cho'qqidan emas.

• **🧱 SMC Zonalari (OB, Breaker, FVG):** Demand OB: 4590.53 - 4592.24 (mitigatsiya kutilmoqda). FVG 50% CE: 4594.69 — bizning Limit kirishimiz aynan shu muvozanat nuqtasi ostida. Bullish Breaker 4580.88 SL uchun ikkinchi himoya qatlami. Yuqorida Supply 4622.32 - 4636.13 — TP2/TP3 shu zonaga moslashtirilgan.

• **🎯 Likvidlik & SMT (BSL/SSL Sweeps, SMT Divergence):** BSL 4596.57 allaqachon supurilgan (Swept ✅). SSL 4591.56 hali OCHIQ — narx aynan shu likvidlikni olish uchun pastga qaytishi ehtimoli yuqori, bu bizning Limit kirishimizga ideal yoqilg'i. SMT Bullish (DXY Lower Low / Gold Higher Low) — institutsional nomutanosiblik oltin foydasiga.

• **⚡ ICT Vaqt & Sessiya (Silver Bullet, Judas Swing, Killzones AMD):** London/NY Overlap — eng yuqori likvidli oyna. Power of 3: **Bullish AMD** — Accumulation (4591 Open atrofi) → Manipulation (SSL 4591.56 ga pastga surish = Judas Swing SELL signali aslida tuzoq!) → Distribution yuqoriga. Silver Bullet oynasi (NY AM 10:00-11:00) +$5-10 harakat va'da qilmoqda — TP1 bilan mos.

• **📐 OTE & Ko'p Taymfreym (Fib 0.705, H4 + M15 + M5 Confluence):** OTE 0.705 = 4594.00 — bu "Sweet Spot" bizning aniq kirishimiz. H4: BULLISH + M15: BOS Up + M5 trigger = 94% Confluence. OTE/Judas/Liq dagi "SELL" belgilari trend teskarisi emas — bular faqat retracement (Discount ga qaytish) haritasi, ya'ni BUY uchun chegirmali narx.

💡 3. TREYDER UCHUN AMALIY QOIDALAR VA XATAR BOSHQARUVI:
─────────────────────────────
1. **Lot hajmi:** Depozitning maksimal 1-2% xatari. Misol: $1000 depozit → $10-20 risk → SL $10.20 bo'lsa ≈ 0.01-0.02 lot.
2. **TP1 (4609.30) da pozitsiyaning 50% ni yoping** va SL ni darhol Entry (4594.00) ga — **Bezubitok (BE)** ga ko'chiring. Shundan keyin savdo 100% risksiz.
3. **TP2 (4621.50) da yana 30% yoping**, qolgan 20% ni TP3 (4635.00) gacha trailing stop (M5 swing low ortidan) bilan olib boring.
4. **Bekor qilish sharti:** Agar narx Limit ga tegmasdan 4622.32 (Supply)
